subject: Request: displacement credits + short extension for Novus RFP bake-off
messages:
From: Sally Park <sally@novushealth.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Darren Liu <darren@procurex.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: displacement credits and short extension for RFP bake-off

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Novus is moving into the hands-on phase for the RFP bake-off next Monday. Procurement just flagged that a competing vendor offered to sponsor extended compute for our team, and that's shifted our testing window: we need to run parallel leaderboards across 3 datasets over two weeks, not the single-week run originally scoped.

Can Redwood provide additional eval credits (tokens) to cover the concurrent runs and a two-week extension on the hosted trial? We want to keep the evaluation apples-to-apples and avoid pausing tests mid-stream. I've attached the scope spreadsheet (novus_bakeoff_scope.xlsx) that shows the extra parallel jobs and rough token estimate.

If possible, we need guidance by EOD so we can lock the schedule on our side. Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call to walk the workload.

Thanks,
Sally Park
Head of ML Ops
Novus Health

Attachment: novus_bakeoff_scope.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sally Park <sally@novushealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: displacement credits and short extension for RFP bake-off

Hi Sally — appreciate the heads-up and the scope file.

We can support this. Proposed immediate path:
- Provisional displacement allowance: up to 75,000 eval tokens across the test window (one-time top-up)
- Trial extension: +14 days on your hosted instance, effective when top-up is applied
- Mutual action plan: quick 20-min call to align on exact datasets and token accounting; we will require a brief one-page addendum for audit/finance (simple AMM).

Next steps for you: confirm the two lead test scripts (names) and a preferred slot for a 20-min sync today or tomorrow. For our side, I'll loop in finance/legal for the addendum and coordinate DocuSign once we finalize numbers.

I'll mark this as high priority and aim to have an approval path by tomorrow morning.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0197

--
Note: this is provisional and contingent on internal approval; I have cc'ed Ben for finance sign-off and Marissa for SRE capacity planning.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 08:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: displacement credits and short extension for RFP bake-off

Grace / Marissa — approve one-time eval stipend to support competitive bake-off under the following guardrails:
- Financial equivalent cap: $3,000 USD (we'll map to token top-up internally; target ~75k tokens as proposed)
- Extension: 14 calendar days on hosted trial; no change to production SLA
- Paperwork: counter-signed addendum + NDA on file before funds/credits are applied

Grace — please open the internal trial-topup ticket with code FIN-TRIAL-2027-021 and attach the MA addendum. I attached the standard NDA we use for quick procurements (MA-NonDisclosure.pdf). Once legal confirms, ops can push the top-up same day.

Ben
Head of Growth Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachment: MA-NonDisclosure.pdf (PDF, 12KB)
